The protected base of the world at **Y −256**. It stops hand mining, tools and drills.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Occurs naturally at the world floor. It cannot be mined or collected in Survival. Its registered catalog entry is not a placeable item.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
